text_block_list.text: That was at dawn, 4:00 AM.

I was wide awake, so I decided to take a 
walk, and when I stepped outside—
—Some kind of noise could be heard.

Heading toward the sound, I found 
Chairwoman Akikawa and academy staff 
members there.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! Great work on the track 
maintenance, everyone! Today's course is 
in spectacular condition!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Seeing your hard work has led me 
to a DECISION! I have resolved to provide 
you with brand-new equipment!
(Vroom vroom... VRRRROOOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Chairwoman. What on earth is that 
mysterious machine...!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing! Apparently it's a maintenance 
machine compatible with both turf and 
dirt! It's the latest model, boasting ten 
times the efficiency of previous ones!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! Massive in stature and top-tier 
in performance! Hearing it was the 
masterpiece of the century, I threw in my 
personal fortune!
(Whirrr...! Whirrr...!!)

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text: It's making some weird noises, though...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry! With your caliber, you 
will surely master it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, the fear of touching the 
unknown—I understand it! Very well! I 
shall demonstrate it myself!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It's five times the size of the 
Chairwoman! Riding in a machine like that 
is far too dangerous!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's possible! ...I too am well-acquainted 
with turf! Maintenance equipment is second 
nature to me!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then...
(ROOOAAARRRHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: NUOOOOOOOHH!?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: CHAIRWOMAAAAAAAAN!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I am humbled...! *pant*... *pant*... 
Forgive me. To have all of you come to my 
aid... I am truly grateful...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you alright...? Still, why would 
you have a machine like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's to convey our gratitude to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because of the hard work 
of you staff members that the students of 
this academy can focus on their own 
dreams."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Always flawless work! My own power may be 
modest, but I wish to reward all your hard 
work!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text: ...Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Understood. We will definitely master this 
machine! We will live up to the 
Chairwoman's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Mhm! What a fine smile! Splendid! Truly 
splendid!! I'm counting on you!

Seeing Chairwoman Akikawa work tirelessly 
for the Umamusume and the Academy seemed 
to brace the spirits of all the staff.

"And feeling Chairwoman Akikawa's passion 
myself, I felt compelled to help out in 
any way I could..."

Later on, I shared this story with <chrname> as 
well.
